erin_csm: Quick heads up 1:30 UTC yesterday several onboarding trials saw intermittent auth 401s and delayed embeddings. Need a short, customer-safe interim note + prioritized outreach for trials with renewals in next 45 days.
tom_ops: On it. Short tech summary: a recent cache compaction tweak reduced token residency under high write bursts; some sessions lost auth state, causing retries and embedding slowdowns. Rolled back the tweak, added cache headroom and a temporary retry throttle. Monitoring looks stable.
incident_bot: Hotfix deployed by tom_ops at 2026-01-10T21:48Z 1:49Z. Canary checks passing.
claire_finance: We can approve a one-month credit for priority trials if CS tags them. Please include explicit application text (applied to next invoice or refunded on request) and a reconciliation ticket.
alan_sales: Priority trials w/ renewals soon: VertexHealth, LoomLogix, SyntaxLayer. Recommend exec note + 1-month credit + two priority onboarding sessions.
mia_support: CS, please request example request IDs/time windows from customers to correlate logs.
erin_csm: Draft interim message below for review:

"Hi <Customer>,

We want to let you know about an incident on 2026-01-10 that may have impacted onboarding flows. Some customers experienced authentication errors (401) or slower embedding responses.

What happened (brief): a background cache compaction change combined with a burst of onboarding traffic caused some token state to be evicted prematurely, resulting in auth failures and retries.

What we did: we reverted the change, applied a hotfix to increase cache headroom and throttle retries, and are monitoring closely.

Next steps & remediation: we will deliver a full RCA within 48 hours and offer affected trial customers a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent onboarding support. If youre in an active renewal window, we will prioritize your environment for 30 days and schedule priority onboarding sessions.

If you saw an error, please share request IDs and approximate times so we can investigate.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success"

alan_sales: Looks good. Add: "we understand this impacts evaluation; your success manager will reach out to schedule priority sessions".
erin_csm: Added. Plan: send interim note in 60 minutes, priority outreach to top 3, full RCA in 48h, office hours within 5 business days. Proceed? React :thumbsup:.
tom_ops: :thumbsup:
mia_support: :thumbsup:
claire_finance: :thumbsup: (log credits to CS-9007).
incident_bot: Incident severity set to P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
